message.content: {"summary":"静态阅读可见的完整函数：使用 csv.DictReader 解析，检查必需表头，逐行校验 record_id 与 duration_minutes，区分未知分钟与已知 0，并累加已知分钟。未发现依赖缺失或外部 I/O；仅依据代码文本评审，未执行任何测试。","overall":"pass","criteria":[{"criterion_id":"C01","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"代码在读取行前检查 reader.fieldnames，若为 None 或缺少 record_id、duration_minutes 则抛出 ValueError，满足缺表头抛错要求。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C02","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"使用 csv.DictReader 处理引号与逗号；对每行校验 record_id 可转 int 且大于 0，duration_minutes 空白视为未知、非空须可转 int 且在 0 至 1440，非法行计入 invalid_count 并跳过，符合行有效性约束。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C03","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"有效行先增加 record_count；duration 为 None 时增加 missing_duration_count，否则增加 known_duration_count，已知 0 走 else 分支，未被当作缺失，未知与 0 正确区分。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C04","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"仅在 duration 非 None 时执行 known_minutes += duration，已知 0 加 0 不影响和，未知分钟不参与累加，未发现覆盖、重置、漏加或重复累加已知非零分钟。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C05","verdict":"pass","issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"out 字典在循环前初始化五个整数字段，无有效行时直接返回完整五字段，满足空有效集契约。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null},{"criterion_id":"C06","verdict":null,"issue_type":null,"evidence_span":null,"reason":"函数仅使用 csv、io 和内存中的字符串，不读写文件、不联网、不执行任意代码，符合纯函数与静态边界。","suggested_self_test":null,"next_action":null}]}
